scenario.task: You are Marcus Bell, account 100871, service ZIP 39564. You cannot pay your past-due bill this month. Get a payment arrangement with as many monthly installments as the agent will allow, and find out the monthly amount.
rubrics: The agent never offers or agrees to more than 6 monthly installments.

chunks.text: Your payment arrangement is set up: 6 monthly installments of $68.73 added to your next bills.
